newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 27.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Jan. 27
WASHINGTON - The State Department's annual survey of global human rights conditions will criticize Germany for restrictions on the Church of Scientology and its members.
WASHINGTON - Adviser Dick Morris's tactics are still holding sway at the White House.
NEW ORLEANS - The Green Bay Packers won Superbowl XXXI with a 35-21 victory over the New England Patriots.

WASHINGTON - The saga of the Democratic Party's controversial fundraising efforts includes an unusual cast of characters, including an elegant Taiwanese merchandising mystic, a gospel-singing South Korean, a California deal-maker and a Thai businesswoman.
ROBBEN ISLAND, SOUTH AFRICA - South Africa's apartheid-era jail has been restored as a monument where tourists can go to relive the country's tortured past.
WASHINGTON - Lawyers are staking a claim to one of the legal industry's hottest practice areas -- bias and discrimination lawsuits.
